Name: vyranity's Witchcraft Creatures for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from vyranity, I've converted their Witchcraft Creatures (mod was originally found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8501]here[/url] but it's been hidden because vyranity didn't personally like it...I, however, enjoyed this one a lot and held onto it, and was given the go-ahead to bring it back to life :)) Credit goes to vyranity for the original mod.

This one includes a few different creatures:

Coop Creatures:

﻿Bats - black and red bats, they drop wings, fur, and teeth
Black cats - black cats that drop hair, hairballs, horseshoes, and Essence of Bad Luck
Rats - Rats drop cave carrots and cheese
Mini Ents - Mini Ents drop hazelnuts and magical leaves

Barn Creatures:

Ghosts - ghosts that give ghost slime and plasma with the milk pail
Griffins - griffins that shed feathers and lay eggs that can be turned into mayo

Enjoy!
